# Contract Analyzer - Update Term

Companion workflow to Contract Analyzer. Lets the Results screen persist a
manually-edited term value back to the same extractions row, instead of the
edit only existing in the browser tab. This is the CRUD half of the
Uncertainty-as-UX-Feature / Tight-Feedback-Loops idea — a human can correct
an extraction and have that correction actually stick.

## How it works
1. Frontend already holds the full key_terms array in memory after analysis.
2. When a term is edited, the frontend sends the WHOLE updated key_terms array
   back here (not just the one changed field) — simplest possible merge logic,
   no server-side JSONB patching required.
3. This workflow PATCHes the extractions row by id and returns the saved result.

## Setup
1. Import, reconnect the Supabase credential (service role — same as Contract
   Analyzer's), publish.
2. Set this workflow's Settings → Error Workflow to "Contract Analyzer - Error
   Handler" too, same as the main workflow.
3. Copy the production webhook URL into frontend/config.js as updateWebhookUrl.
4. Replace allowedOrigins with your real Vercel domain once deployed.

## Error handling (v2)
Update Extraction in Supabase now has an explicit error branch — 3 retries,
1s apart, then a 502 telling the frontend the save did NOT persist, instead
of the PATCH failing silently and the UI showing a correction that was never
actually saved.

## What this does NOT do
No audit history of prior values, no re-verification against the source text,
no permissions check on who's allowed to edit — a real version would need all
three. Fine for a demo whose point is showing the loop exists at all.
